full_prompt_en: A square Baroque oil painting shows a bearded man in a deep red robe looking upward from a dark, nearly empty background. The rear field is mostly umber-black, subtly warmer and lighter behind his right shoulder, but no room or landscape details are defined. His upper body fills the lower two-thirds of the frame. Dark curly hair spreads around his temples and ears, and a thick black beard covers his jaw and upper chest. His head tilts back and toward the upper left. The eyes follow a point above the frame, with lifted brows and a slightly parted mouth giving the face an earnest, questioning expression. Warm light strikes his forehead, nose, cheekbones, and exposed throat from above left, while the underside of the beard remains deep brown-black. The robe wraps loosely across his shoulders and chest, opening at the throat. Its crimson and rust-colored folds are painted with broad, heavy strokes and sink rapidly into shadow at the lower edge. On the right side, one raised hand emerges from the robe with its palm tilted upward and fingers partly curled. Small highlights on the knuckles and fingertips separate the gesture from the dark background. The other arm is absorbed in the red drapery and cannot be clearly followed. The close crop prevents any narrative setting from competing with the face and hand. Strong directional light creates a clear division between illuminated flesh and the velvety surrounding dark, while warm red fabric supplies the only large color accent. The overall composition is concentrated and dramatic, bringing gaze, gesture, and rich shadow together in a single upward movement.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形巴洛克油画描绘一名蓄须男子，身穿深红长袍，从黑暗、近乎空无的背景前仰望。后方色域大多为棕黑色，在他右肩后略暖、略亮，但看不出具体房间或风景。他的上身填满下方三分之二。深色卷发围着太阳穴和耳朵，厚重黑胡须覆盖下颌与上胸。头向后、向左上倾。眼睛追随画幅上方某处，扬起的眉和微张的嘴赋予脸部恳切、探寻的表情。暖光从左上照到额头、鼻梁、颧骨和露出的喉颈，胡须下侧则保持深棕黑色。长袍松松裹过肩和胸，在喉部敞开。深红与铁锈色褶面以宽厚笔触画出，并在下缘迅速沉入阴影。右侧，一只抬起的手从长袍中伸出，掌心向上倾，手指微弯。指节与指尖的小高光将动作从深色背景中分开。另一条手臂被红色衣褶吸收，无法清楚追踪。紧密裁切让任何叙事情境都不能与面孔和手竞争。强定向光明确分开受光皮肤与绒般的周围黑暗，暖红布料则提供唯一大片色彩重音。整体构图集中而戏剧化，把目光、手势与浓厚阴影聚成一个向上的运动。
style_prompt_en: The Baroque oil surface uses near-black brown as a deep, continuous ground and lifts a small group of forms with warm directional light. Rust red and dark crimson provide a broad color mass, while pale ocher highlights appear only on selected raised planes. Rounded volumes are modeled through strong value transitions, with some edges crisp in light and others entirely lost in shadow. Broad, visible brushwork gives folded surfaces weight; smoother blending keeps the brightest surfaces luminous. The frame is closely cropped and sparse in background detail, concentrating attention on a few connected gestures and tonal accents. Light from above one side creates chiaroscuro without cool reflected color. Dark space surrounds the central form and strengthens its upward visual movement. The overall effect is solemn, intense, and tactile, with dramatic restraint rather than decorative abundance.
style_prompt_zh: 巴洛克油画表面以近黑棕色作深而连续的底面，用暖色定向光托起一小组形态。铁锈红与深绯红形成宽阔色团，浅赭高光只落在少数凸起平面。圆润体积通过强烈明度转折塑造，部分边缘在光中清晰，另一些则完全消失于阴影。宽阔可见笔触赋予褶面重量；较平滑的融合让最亮表面显得发光。画幅裁切靠近、背景细节稀少，注意力集中于相连的少数动作与明度重音。一侧上方来光形成明暗对照，几乎没有冷色反射。深色空间围住中央形体，并强化其向上的视觉运动。整体效果肃穆、强烈而可触，力量来自戏剧性的克制，而非繁复装饰。
theme_en: A bearded man in a red robe looking upward with one hand raised
theme_zh: 身穿红袍、抬手仰望的蓄须男子
name: Jusepe de Ribera
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
